question: Can the same parameter sets reproduce MSM HIV diagnoses AND RIVM MSM AIDS under the declared assumptions (clinical-AIDS observation proxy; two-era effective on-ART progression; predictive variance s(x)+s(x)/K)?
success_criterion: Joint NROY members in wave 2 under the primary rule, with mechanisms explainable. Survivors alone are not success; an empty joint set is a reportable limitation, not a reason to widen tolerances.

decisions_recorded.on_art_progression: Decision B: effective all-ART rate, early <=2000, linear ramp, recent >=2010; early 0.002-0.030 (assumption), recent 0.002-0.008 (SHM 2025 anchored). No early>=recent constraint; report the implied ordering among survivors.
decisions_recorded.ecdc_hiv_1990_1995: Hold out as one-sided cross-validation (survivor-restricted registration).

limitations: Wave 1 scores SHM MSM diagnoses only (7 anchors). In the 2026-09-16 diagnostic run no point passed this block alone (min I_max 3.57 over 400 points in 32 dims); wave 1 may again retain fewer than 10 points, which stops the sequence for review.
Warm-start rows (22) propose points only; 14 had chronic_to_aids_on_art clipped into the new recent range.
Wave 2 samples the bounding box of wave-1 NROY thinned by proximity: a superset approximation, not an exhaustive plausible region.
K=5 replicates: s(x) has 4 df; the chi-square stability diagnostic is reported, not corrected.
Before 1996 only RIVM MSM AIDS 1990 and 1995 constrain the epidemic (wave 2); those come from the voluntary Inspectorate AIDS registry with unquantified completeness.
V_obs underivable (zero) for every scored target.
No output may be called a posterior or final calibration ensemble.

rationale.max_waves: Wave 1 diagnoses-only discovery; wave 2 adds AIDS cumulatively.
rationale.min_volume_shrinkage: Not used for a two-wave staged sequence.
rationale.min_nroy_members: Fewer than 10 diagnosis-compatible points is too sparse to seed the AIDS stage; stop and review.

discrepancy.rationale: Unchanged from the diagnostic wave; declared assumption.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: target_relative_20pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: Diagnostic only; never continues the sequence.

waves.comment: Diagnoses-only discovery over the full 33-parameter prior box plus 22 declared warm-start proposals.
AIDS added cumulatively; diagnosis constraints retained.

post_run_report_required: joint NROY membership and binding targets per wave
implied ordering of chronic_to_aids_on_art_early vs _recent among survivors (declining/flat/increasing)
one-sided ECDC 1990-95 check: fraction of survivors with model new_diagnoses >= observed
